title: RAII cleanup for shell meshes and acceleration structures
purpose: Eliminate exit-time VUIDs and ensure deterministic teardown of shell-related resources.

steps.detail: Introduce RAII wrappers for: vertex/index buffers (device address), BLAS buffers, TLAS buffer, instance buffer. Ensure move-only semantics and deterministic destruction order (TLAS → BLAS → buffers).
On shell threshold change or shutdown: vkDeviceWaitIdle() → destroy TLAS → destroy BLAS → free buffers. Null handles after destroy.
Add debug asserts/logs enumerating live shell buffers/images/AS at destroy time; count must be zero.

acceptance: No exit-time VUID 05137 for shell resources
No live buffers/images reported at device destroy
mcp_queries: search_vulkan_spec('Object lifetime and destruction order requirements')
notes: Consider integrating VMA for allocation tracking; until then, manual bookkeeping with clear ownership is required.
